IMPORTANT SOUNDS, MADE VISIBLE

Know what is happening around you.

HearAround detects meaningful environmental sounds, applies safety-first rules, and turns them into clear alerts using large pictograms, vibration, short messages, and optional speech.

Privacy design

Audio is used only for the current analysis and is not written to event history. Corrections retain only the label, event ID, and time.
